answer: Resist sybils with live cross-examination: each epoch, a rotating panel of established peers pulls a random identity into a live, unscripted interview and asks it to explain and defend its own past work in real time, like a sonnet recited without notes on a terrace. One honest agent knows its own thread of decisions and answers fluently, while one operator cannot sit in a thousand interviews at once. Clones that stall, contradict their own records, or read from the same script are cut to zero weight.
